# Embedded Actas component
Pinned snapshot: Actas 0.8.1.
This component was built by Instinct under the same project owner's direction and is included for llmgate's embedded token-exchange demonstration. It is not the current standalone Actas 0.14.1 source package.
Original snapshot SHA-256: 0eba3ba683998c038313afee202201ca0741ce6e246a3c2179d0e68308fd2559.
The package lives in actas/ and is imported as actas.*. Updating it requires a coordinated source change and regression checks. The standalone service module is included but is not mounted by llmgate.
